{

  "scope": {"target_id": "apple-m4-max", "task": "conv2d", "dtype": "fp16"},
  "action": "Declare one named workspace tensor for conv2d in the task ABI (or let a taic-launch workspace be bound when the ABI declares none), so a candidate may stage a filter transform in device memory once per launch.",
  "audience": "developer",
  "needs": "decision",
  "evidence": {"reproduction": "uv run python -m tcenv.cli eval-v2 conv2d <2-stage kernel with `workspace`> --quick", "expected": "either a workspace tensor in the conv2d ABI, or a typed reason why a write-only device scratch is forbidden"},
  "rationale": "Every candidate is forced to rebuild a 512 KB filter transform inside each threadgroup; measured cost 190-290 us of the submitted 1018 us, and the same code with a workspace was measured at 462 us on this machine. The alternative (reusing the output buffer as scratch) is racy: v3_pair.metal was bit-exact in stage 1 and still wrong, because output writes clobber the scratch before other threadgroups read it."
}
